title: The Baby Clause
overview: Bianca is a 30-something attorney who has everything she could want (great friends, great job, great support system) except a baby. After a series of terrible dates and dead-end relationships, Bianca decides she's going to find an in-person sperm donor to give her the baby she's always wanted and avoid the hassle of a husband she can't trust. Enter Gabby - a precocious pre-teen with an absentee mother and a busy single dad (Donovan) who spends every waking moment (much to Donovan's chagrin) with her best friend/neighbor, Taylor. Gabby sets her sights and her heart on Bianca filling the mom-sized hole in her heart. Donovan, for his part, has enough on his plate as a marketing executive and single dad and doesn't need the additional distraction Bianca creates. Can Donovan get out of his own way and find his way into stone-cold Bianca's heart? Will Gabby's mom become an issue? Will Donovan ever get Taylor out of the house?
